Tagore's own English prose version of 103 of his Bengali songs (1912), the book for which he received the Nobel Prize.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941), Gitanjali (Song Offerings), 1912, in his own English prose translation, with an introduction by W. B. Yeats (1865–1939). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
